guidance: So, our FY27 outlook is, looking ahead we remain highly optimistic about the future.
Based on our current visibility and expansion plans, we remain confident of delivering approximately 25% to 30% annual growth while continuing to improve profitability and brand strength.
capex: However, while FY26 was about strengthening the foundation, FY27 will be all about expansion and category creation.
In line with this vision, we are pleased to announce our planned expansion into Quick Comm during FY27.
risks: As a disclaimer, I would like to inform all of you that this call may contain forward-looking statements which may involve risk and uncertainties.
We see because of the accessories not having the challenges which fashion has, the margins will improve there as well.
focus: So, we are launching Fitness Exchange as a separate brand which will operate in the semi-premium affordable segment and will focus on active wear, athleisure, sports-inspired fashion and also accessories.
So, strategically, FTX will continue focusing on scale, creation in the economy fashion segment targeting Gen Z.
TRIBE will focus on premiumization and margin expansion and Fitness Exchange will target the rapidly growing athleisure opportunity across age groups.
